packageRules.description: Minor and patch updates merge themselves once the checks pass
docker-compose.yml is the usage example and names this repo's own image on purpose; bumping it there would only ever point readers at a stale digest
A runtime dependency bump changes the published image, so it is a fix: release-please cuts a patch release for it. devDependencies and workflow-action bumps fall back to chore and release nothing.
A base-image bump changes the published image too, so it is a fix as well.
